messages:
Alex M.: noticed a spike in 429s for the embeddings/rerank lane in eu-west around 10:03 UTC, looks like queue depth hit the lane cap.
Priya R.: saw it too, dashboards show sustained GPU utilization at 98% on the rerank pool. Spiky arrival pattern from customer X.
Marco G.: are these 429s coming from admission control or an upstream LB timeout? logs show 'admission_rejected: lane_capacity' 429s.
Lina S.: ops-bot alerted about sudden headroom loss and we had horizontal autoscaler at max replicas. No new nodes provisioned due to region quota.
Jamal T.: region quota? we hit AWS instance limit for g5s in eu-west-1, so autoscaler can't add GPUs. I filed a quota increase request but ETA ~6h.
Alex M.: ok, immediate mitigation ideas: 1) soften admission control threshold for rerank to 85% from 80% for 30m window, 2) spill low-priority rerank to CPU fallback (quantized model) with higher latency but lower cost, 3) route some traffic to us-east if cross-region latency acceptable. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 
Priya R.: I like (2) as quick toggle. We already have a "fallback_model": "rerank-lite-4bit" in config. Can flip traffic by tag. (3) requires routing policy change and has auth/data concerns for EU customers.
Marco G.: (1) is risky, could increase latency for high-priority requests. But we can do a phased soft admission: admit up to 90% for low-priority customer tiers only. Add additional queueing token for canary 10% of traffic.
Lina S.: ops: We can provision a transient spot pool in eu-west-1 with lower reliability but faster to spin up. Would need autoscaler cooldown change and node taints to isolate rerank.
Jamal T.: spot pool is fine if we label as burst-capacity. I'll open an ephemeral nodegroup and set maxSurge=2. ETA ~20 min.
Alex M.: good. Meanwhile can someone flip the fallback route for customer X to rerank-lite? Priya?
Priya R.: doing it now. patching admission rule: 
```
admission_control:
  lanes:
    rerank:
      soft_threshold_pct: 85
      hard_threshold_pct: 95
      spill_policy:
        - tag: low_priority -> model: rerank-lite-4bit
        - tag: burst -> route: spot-burst-pool
```
Applying change...
Priya R.: change rolled, starting to see 429 rate drop from 12% -> 3% in 5m. latency for those spilled requests increased ~120ms median.
Marco G.: good signal. ops-bot: can you keep an eye on rebalancer? I want automated spillback once nodegroup is healthy.
ops-bot: rebalancer monitoring enabled, will trigger spillback when avg_gpu_util < 70% for 5m.
Lina S.: after spot pool up, autoscaler created 2 nodes, rerank pool capacity +40% within 18m.
Jamal T.: confirmed quota increase request approved but stewarded to non-critical; spot pool covers immediate.
Alex M.: action items: (a) keep rerank soft threshold as-is for next 2h, (b) run postmortem on traffic shaping for customer X (Priya), (c) add region quota alert to paging rules (Lina), (d) explore persistent cross-region burst lanes ops (Marco).
Priya R.: will own postmortem, adding request samples to eval set to prevent future thrashing.
Marco G.: also propose a small change to admission scoring: consider prefix cache hit as higher priority so cached rerank goes through even when lane near-capacity.
Lina S.: noted. I'll add quota escalation runbook and a step to pre-warm spot pool when predicted traffic > 70% for 3h.
Alex M.: thanks all. tagging follow-ups in the incident doc and closing thread once postmortem draft is in. :white_check_mark:
